response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile full-stack and systems engineer with over a decade of production experience, but his background is overwhelmingly in general web/backend development rather than AI-driven solutions. He lacks demonstrated experience with cloud-native AI system design, vector databases, RAG architectures, or multi-agent frameworks, and his current role only briefly mentions MCP tooling and agentic infrastructure without depth or specifics. This does not meet the core required qualifications for a Staff Forward Deployed GenAI Engineer role.
strengths: 18+ years of diverse, production-grade software engineering experience across web, mobile, and embedded systems
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and workshop/training delivery experience
Recent exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agentic workflow infrastructure at re:cinq
concerns: No evident hands-on experience with RAG architectures, vector databases, or LLM evaluation/observability pipelines
No demonstrated experience designing AI systems on major cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) specifically for AI workloads
AI/GenAI experience appears very recent and thin relative to the 8+ years required in AI-driven solution development

key_factors.factor: Lack of RAG/vector DB/AI system design experience
Minimal and recent GenAI/agentic systems exposure
Strong general engineering seniority and leadership track record
